entities.summary: Filip Stanisław Adwent was a Polish politician and a Member of the European Parliament for the Pomeranian Voivodship. He was born in Strasbourg. He ran as a candidate from the League of Polish Families, and sat on the European Parliament's Committee on Agriculture and Rural Development.
